name: assertion-memory
description: Persistent, structured project memory across sessions, projects, and agents — for OpenAI Codex.
_comment: Codex plugin manifest. Codex loads lifecycle hooks ONLY from an installed+enabled plugin cache (or an interactive TUI config layer) — NOT from loose files and NOT under `codex exec`. The hooks.json here is the SAME shape as the Claude Code plugin and points at the SAME shared scripts in ../scripts (one copy of the logic). Install path: `codex plugin marketplace add <repo-root>` then enable `assertion-memory` from `/plugins` in an interactive Codex session.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent project memory across sessions and agents.
